name: Ridge Card
description: A card holding a mountain range in depth: five ridges that shift with parallax as the card tilts, with haze drifting between them.

props.name: mood
props.description: Light and colour of the scene: the sky, the sun or moon, the haze and the colour of the snow.

props.name: seed
props.description: Shapes the five ridgelines, their snowfields and forests.

props.name: maxTilt
props.description: Largest tilt of the card toward the pointer, in degrees. Near ridges shift more than far ones.

props.name: children
props.description: Content placed over the lower ridges, in a padded layer at the bottom. It reads light text over the dark foothills, and ink in the snow mood.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer element. Set the width here; the card keeps a 19:23 shape. Also accepts every other prop of a div.
